hints.title: Monotonic Row and Column Ordering
hints.text: Each row and column is sorted in non-increasing order. Negative numbers form a staircase contour at bottom-right.

hints.title: Start at Bottom-Left or Top-Right
hints.text: Start at cell (0, n - 1) or (m - 1, 0). Move left when negative, or move down when non-negative.

hints.title: Accumulate Negatives in Linear Steps
hints.text: From (r, c), if grid[r][c] < 0, all cells below it in that column are also negative: add (m - r) and move left c -= 1.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning every cell takes O(M * N); binary search per row takes O(M * log(N)).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Staircase traversal leverages dual monotonic row and column order to achieve linear time O(M + N).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate implements optimal staircase walk in O(M + N) without inspecting every cell.
complexity.notes: Initial position at top-right (r = 0, c = n - 1).
